    def _drop_item_content(self, sequence, item_vectors):
        # Neither path creates a generator or consumes augmentation randomness.
        if not self.training or self.content_dropout_p == 0.0:
            return item_vectors
        device = item_vectors.device
        generator = self._augmentation_generator
        if generator is None:
            generator = torch.Generator(device=device)
            generator.manual_seed(42)
            if self._augmentation_state is not None:
                if self._augmentation_device != str(generator.device):
                    raise RuntimeError("Augmentation resume requires the original compatible device")
                generator.set_state(self._augmentation_state)
            self._augmentation_generator = generator
            self._augmentation_state = None
        elif generator.device != device:
            raise RuntimeError("Move the model before starting augmentation")
        valid = sequence.ne(0)
        first = valid & valid.long().cumsum(dim=1).eq(1)
        draws = torch.rand((*sequence.shape, 1), device=device, generator=generator)
        erase = (valid & ~first).unsqueeze(-1) & draws.lt(self.content_dropout_p)
        return item_vectors.masked_fill(erase, 0.0)
